title: Finland's Welfare State Under Strain · 12 Oct
keywords: Finland, fiscal policy, austerity, welfare state, coalition politics, Finns Party, National Coalition, budget deficit, EU fiscal rules, unemployment, retirement age, home-care allowance, Petteri Orpo, Social Democrats, European economy
notes: Finland is navigating a deepening fiscal crisis, with a projected deficit well above EU limits and a debt load approaching 90 percent of GDP. The government's consolidation strategy is triggering sharp political and social conflict, splitting opinion along lines of class, age and ideology. Within the governing coalition itself, the Finns Party has overtaken the prime minister's own party in polling, raising the stakes of every budget decision.
